summary:
SL-007 re-validated at HEAD e912d6b. The scope was stale: since cc22a1e the only src changes are CommandLine.cs:99, where `StartsWith("--")` became `argument == ReportOption`, and App.xaml.cs:9, which now reads that same const. All 14 cases hold.

**Measured on the real exe.** I published the single-file Release exe from a clean HEAD into a scratch folder whose path has a space. I drove it on this PC as an ordinary Medium-integrity account through ProcessStartInfo, Start-Process and cmd /c. The runs used real deny rules, the real C:\ root and links planted mid-scan.
- **Finish line 1:** exits 0 by every route, with root `<tree>\` and the control's core (Completed, 20 files, 4 folders).
- **Finish line 2:** exits 0 and writes the report at the exact `out  dir` path, two spaces included.
- **`"<tree>\"` alone:** keeps its window up.
- **`"<tree>\" extra --report …`:** exits 2 at 155 ms with no window.
- **Unwritable report folders:** Deny CreateFiles, a create-only drop folder and `"C:\" --report C:\r.json` each exit 3 within 146–252 ms, with no window and nothing left behind.
- **Planted links:** links at `<report>.tmp` and at `<report>` leave the sentinel untouched.
- **O-053, the line my last pass failed on:** `"<tree>\" --report "<r>\out --old\dash.json"` now exits 0 with the right root. On cc22a1e's published exe it exited 2.

**Tests and rules.**
- Whole suite: 1451 of 1451.
- Bug project: 8 of 8.
- Fitness: 114 rules hold.
- Window cases C-007 and C-008 pass on an artifacts/publish rebuilt from HEAD.
- Running the fresh Core dll directly on 23 lines shows the narrowing still refuses or falls back on every IN-M1 shape.

Nothing that this slice wrote or was required to write is open.

criteria.criterion: 1. Split the line: a quoted root ending in one backslash, then --report and a path, which Windows merges into one argument (`"D:\Data\" --report out.json`, `"C:\" --report C:\r.json`)
criteria.how: The fresh Core dll gives [D:\Data\, --report, out.json] and [C:\, --report, C:\r.json] from the one merged argv element. CommandLineTests.AQuotedRootEndingInABackslashThenReportIsSplitAsTyped passes in the 1451-test suite.

criteria.criterion: 2. Split the line: the root and a quoted report path both contain spaces, and the report path has a run of two spaces
criteria.how: The fresh Core dll gives [D:\My Data\, --report, C:\out  dir\r.json] from argv's 2 elements, with the two spaces kept. ASpacedRootAndASpacedReportPathKeepTheirSpaces passes.

criteria.criterion: 3. Split the line: a quoted root ending in a backslash with nothing after it, so argv's only '"' is its last character
criteria.how: The fresh Core dll gives [D:\Data\] from argv [D:\Data"]. AQuotedRootEndingInABackslashAloneIsTheFolder passes.

criteria.criterion: 4. Split the line: a line Windows split cleanly, with no '"' left in argv
criteria.how: `"D:\Data"`, the even run `"D:\Data\\"`, unquoted `C:\` and the root last all come back exactly as argv. ALineWindowsSplitCleanlyIsReturnedAsItCame passes.

criteria.criterion: 5. Split the line: the typed line does not account for argv; an inner '"' gives null and a trailing-only '"' gives argv unchanged
criteria.how: `D:\Data\" --report "C:\out\" x` gives NULL, and the unpaired trailing-only lines keep argv. ALineThatDoesNotMatchItsArgvIsRefusedOrLeftAlone passes.

criteria.criterion: 6. Split the line: the grammar the new tokeniser opens, one row each, plus the corpus roots A01-A10 hand-quoted
criteria.how: TheGrammarTheRepairOpensIsSplitAsTyped and AppArgumentTests.EveryRootOfTheCorpusHandQuotedIsRepairedByArguments pass in the suite. Two \" in one line and the odd run of 3 were also measured directly, the odd run on the published exe as well.

criteria.criterion: 7. Unattended report: the exe started as `"<tree>\" --report "<file>"` (finish line 1)
criteria.how: Published single-file exe: exit 0 through psi (761 ms), Start-Process (801 ms) and cmd /c (769 ms). Root <tree\>, with the control's core (Completed, 20 files, 4 folders). The bug project's repro passes too.

criteria.criterion: 8. Unattended report: a spaced quoted root and a report path whose folder has two spaces (finish line 2)
criteria.how: Published exe: exit 0 via psi and Start-Process, with the report at the exact `out  dir` path and root <tree sp\>. The bug project's ASpacedRootAndAReportPathWithTwoSpacesAreTakenWhole passes.

criteria.criterion: 9. Open the window: the exe started as `"<tree>\"` with nothing after it (finish line 3)
criteria.how: Published exe: the window appeared at 398 ms and the process was still running at 3019 ms. Whether the interactive window shows that exact folder was not checked by UI automation; the exe runs report mode on the same repaired root.

criteria.criterion: 10. Refuse a report line it cannot take: `"<tree>\" extra --report "<file>"` (finish line 4)
criteria.how: Published exe: exit 2 at 155 ms, no window, no report. The bug project's fact passes.

criteria.criterion: 11. Refuse a report path it cannot write: the folder exists but the account cannot create a file in it (Deny CreateFiles), as an ordinary user meets with `C:\ --report C:\r.json`
criteria.how:
Published exe as a Medium-integrity account:
- Deny CreateFiles: exit 3 at 146 ms.
- Create-only drop folder: exit 3 at 146 ms.
- `"C:\" --report C:\r.json` on the real C:\: exit 3 at 252 ms.

None opened a window or left a file.

criteria.criterion: 12. Create the probe and the temporary: each open draws its own name at that moment; the probe leaves nothing; a failed move removes the temporary
criteria.how: ReportFileTests pass in the suite, including AFreshStemIsDrawnForEachOpenAtTheMomentOfOpening, AProbeLeavesAWritableFolderAsItWas and AFailedMoveLeavesNoTemporary. ReportFile.cs is unchanged since my previous pass. Every exe run left no .fsa-* or .tmp entry.

criteria.criterion: 13. Write without writing through a planted link already at the target name (temporary, <report>, the old fixed <report>.tmp)
criteria.how: On the published exe, a hardlink at r.json.tmp and a hardlink or dangling symlink at r.json, all planted mid-scan, left the sentinel ORIGINAL. r.json was a regular single-name file and every run exited 0. The ReportFileTests corpus rows pass in the suite.

criteria.criterion: 14. Write without writing through a planted link: a dangling symlink planted at the temporary's exact fresh name
criteria.how: I measured that raw CreateNew follows a dangling symlink, which is the design's recorded residual (T07). The defence the design chose is a name drawn per open, at the moment of opening. The counting-Func and E01-E03 facts in ReportFileTests pass in the suite. I did not plant at the exe's fresh name, which cannot be predicted from outside.

planned.evidence: The fresh Core dll splits `"D:\Data\" --report out.json` and `"C:\" --report C:\r.json` into 3 arguments each. The CommandLineTests row passes in the 1451/1451 suite.
`"D:\My Data\" --report "C:\out  dir\r.json"` gives [D:\My Data\, --report, C:\out  dir\r.json], both spaces kept. The test passes.
`"D:\Data\"` gives [D:\Data\] from argv [D:\Data"]. The test passes.
Clean lines come back unchanged on the fresh dll: quoted without a trailing backslash, the even run, unquoted C:\, and the root last. The test passes.
An inner '"' gives NULL (`D:\Data\" --report "C:\out\" x`), and trailing-only lines keep argv. ALineThatDoesNotMatchItsArgvIsRefusedOrLeftAlone passes.

TheGrammarTheRepairOpensIsSplitAsTyped (16 rows) and EveryRootOfTheCorpusHandQuotedIsRepairedByArguments pass in the suite. Two \" in one line and the odd run of 3 were measured directly, the latter on the published exe (exit 0).
Published exe, `"<tree>\" --report "<r>"`: exit 0 via psi, Start-Process and cmd, with root <tree\> and the control's core.

obligations.evidence: CommandLine.cs:99 now reads `quote < 0 && argument == ReportOption`. The fresh Core dll repairs six dash-folder report paths. The published exe exits 0 on `"<tree>\" --report "<r>\out --old\dash.json"`, where cc22a1e's exe exited 2. CommandLineDashFolderTests passes in the suite, and the bug project's dash fact passes. IN-M1 shapes still fall back or are refused.
The bug project command exited 0 at e912d6b, 8 of 8, with TAAD3_HOME set to a new empty scratch folder.

not_reached: Other Windows builds or ucrtbase versions. Only this PC's Windows 11 10.0.26300 was measured (N-065).
An elevated run, and a run from a second, non-admin-group account.
The interactive window's displayed folder for `"<tree>\"` alone. I saw that a window was up but did not read its contents, which would need UI automation or the startup hook.
A dangling symlink planted at the exe's own fresh temporary name. That name cannot be predicted from outside, so this rests on the unit facts and the design's residual.
A whole-drive unattended run of `C:\ --report <writable>` to completion. Only the up-front refusal on C:\ was measured.
Window cases C-012 and O-016, and WindowMutants, were not re-run this lap. App.xaml.cs changed only by a const.
